NEW OPERATIONAL FINDING: the emitted judge / thesis / implication / narrator prompts put their whole `user` payload on ONE line (43k-185k characters). The Read tool cannot page a single line that long, so three brain subagents fell back to read-only Grep chunking to load their own prompt. Every brain did read its full prompt, but this is fragile and worth a fix (emit the payload pretty-printed, or split `user` to its own file).
